name: Ender 3 V3 SE tune-up and calibration

mentions.name: Ender 3 V3 SE tune-up and calibration
mentions.description: A restoration and calibration project for an Ender 3 V3 SE 3D printer that had been sitting unused, covering fresh filament, cleaning, a mechanical tune-up, and working through Orca Slicer's calibration print suite.
mentions.source_excerpt: Currently, I'm in the midst of ricing my 3D printer - an Ender 3 V3 SE which has been sitting unloved for quite some time. Fresh filament, cleaning, mechanical tuneup, and now running through the very nice suite of calibration prints that are included in Orca slicer (which is new to me).
mentions.author: epiccoleman
